comment: The toolchains of hyper that no other file declares. mise is the release that make install-tools TOOLS=npm installs with the sha256 of each platform; mise.toml declares the tools it installs (the Python of the checks with uv, Composer, and alint of make layout-check) and mise.lock locks them for every platform of the bootstrap (HR-81). pythonBackend is the one declaration of the wheel build backend, which install-tools installs and the release builds the wheels with (H23.17, kit K166).
